arguments.issue: Did the decision-maker properly assess the credibility of the claimant's evidence?
arguments.claim: The decision-maker failed to consider all credible evidence and wrongly concluded the claim was manifestly not credible.
arguments.quote: la SPR n'a pas tenu compte de tous les éléments de preuve, dont de la preuve crédible et digne de foi, pour conclure que la demande était manifestement non crédible.

support.ref: Rahaman c Canada (Ministre de la Citoyenneté et de l'Immigration) (CA), 2002 CAF 89, para 51

arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the decision-maker did consider all evidence and reasonably assessed credibility.

arguments.issue: Did the decision-maker adequately justify the reason for the claimant's dismissal from employment?
arguments.claim: The decision-maker did not justify why the claimant was dismissed for theft rather than political opinions and relied on personal views without objective evidence.
arguments.quote: la SPR ne justifie pas pourquoi elle est convaincue que le demandeur a été licencié en raison du vol plutôt qu’en raison de ses opinions politiques... sans avoir cité, ni s’être référé à des éléments de preuve objectifs dans le cartable national de documentation [CND].
arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the decision-maker's conclusion is supported by evidence and reasonable inferences.
